verdict_reason: Coherence needs SLC pairs, absent from GEE/Planetary Computer (GRD-only, phase discarded). Free cloud InSAR via ASF HyP3 (8,000 free credits/month) satisfies C9. But no public DOA/myGAP source with certified parcel geolocations or validity windows was found, so the certificate-comparison half has no reference.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 GRD (Google Earth Engine, COPERNICUS/S1_GRD)
sources.licence_quote: The use of Sentinel data is governed by the Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions.
sources.coverage_quote: S1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) scenes, processed using the Sentinel-1 Toolbox to generate a calibrated, ortho-corrected product.
caveats_quoted: GEE Sentinel-1 catalog lists GRD only; no SLC or coherence collection is offered.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 GRD (Microsoft Planetary Computer)
sources.licence_quote: Proprietary, governed by Copernicus Sentinel data terms
sources.coverage_quote: Global coverage spanning -180 to 180 longitude and -90 to 90 latitude
caveats_quoted: Pixel values represent detected amplitude with phase information lost, resulting in approximately square resolution pixels with reduced speckle.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 SLC (Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem)
sources.coverage_quote: Rest of World SLC coverage: February 2021 to Present (Europe: October 2014 to Present)
caveats_quoted: SLC only from Feb 2021 outside Europe, so pre-2021 coherence time series over Cameron Highlands is not possible.
Page does not itself name a ready-made coherence product; SLC pairs still need interferometric processing.

sources.name: ASF HyP3 on-demand InSAR (coherence) processing
sources.licence_quote: The coherence file pixel values range from 0.0 to 1.0, with 0.0 being completely non-coherent and 1.0 being perfectly coherent.
sources.coverage_quote: Processing occurs on the HyP3 platform, cloud-based processing of Sentinel-1 without local computational resources.
sources.date_range: on-demand, any Sentinel-1 SLC acquisition date
caveats_quoted: HyP3 Basic On Demand users get a free allotment of 8,000 credits per month; InSAR jobs cost 10 credits (80 m) or 15 credits (40 m) each.
Default InSAR output pixel spacing (40-80 m) is coarse relative to individual plastic-house footprints.

sources.name: myGAP certified parcel registry (Department of Agriculture Malaysia)
caveats_quoted: DOA homepage lists MyPhyto, GeoTanaman, GeoTanih and pesticide-licensing systems; no myGAP certified-parcel list, coordinates, or validity-window portal was found.
Two guessed myGAP sub-page URLs both returned 404 / PHP framework errors, not content.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: No public DOA/myGAP portal with parcel coordinates or certification validity dates was located. Would require a direct data-sharing request to DOA/MPOB; no public API or download confirmed to exist.

compute_path.platform: ASF HyP3 cloud on-demand InSAR (or CDSE openEO) for coherence generation; GEE for any GRD-based auxiliary work
compute_path.why: Coherence generation runs on ASF's free hosted cloud (8,000 credits/month, ~10-15 per pair), not local GPU/SNAP; satisfies C9 despite not being one of its named platforms.
